dict.string: Status Trio processes audio from apps you choose so you can adjust their volume independently. Audio is not saved or uploaded.

Shows Bluetooth connection status, reads battery/model metadata for nearby named devices and devices already trusted by this Mac, and switches noise-control mode on supported headphones; nearby devices are read only when explicitly authorized by BLE UUID.
Used to show the current Wi-Fi network name in the popover and, when you open Wi-Fi details, to read network names, scan results, and connection information.
